scope: Engineering E2 only. Newly authorized by user on 2026-10-25. Separate from the held relapse-prevention study. E3 must have a separate committed protocol and successful E2 gate; E4 additionally needs untouched data.
precision: FP32, no autocast; author-native BF16 memory storage unchanged
native_parity: Fresh-model all_native and all_rebuilt must match native output logits, low-resolution masks, complete per-object output banks and image-cache fingerprints bit for bit at every frame, including prompts. all_native executes gather and sparse RoPE even with every token retained; no identity-path bypass.
sparse_replay: region_native and region_long each repeat with a fresh model; their logits, masks, bank and cache fingerprints must be identical. Predictions need not equal native when tokens/history change; this is not an efficacy endpoint.
spatial_rule: Existing exact mixed-cell native256 labels; retain object interior, mixed boundary and one-token outer background ring in older frames. Prompt/latest frames remain full. Native object-pointer selection and values remain untouched.
long_history: At most 32 total spatial frames, including prompt/latest; maximal finite recent suffix fitting 20,480 older selected keys. Stop at first overflowing older frame. Total read spatial keys <=28,672. Zero-selected frames are finite and contribute no spatial evidence.
temporal_rule: Conditioning prompt uses learned slot 6. Nonconditioning age a>=1 uses slot min(a-1,5); all ages >=6 saturate at oldest native nonconditioning slot 5. Do not expand or train temporal embeddings. This project adaptation loses distinctions among old ages and must be an E3 limitation.
required_checks: all four memory cross-attention layers on every nonprompt frame
raw selected frame values match that frame's actual stored native memory
author pruned RoPE preserves original spatial frequencies
attention read does not mutate captured native memory buffers
actual gathered key lengths match receipts and budget
at least one region_long read contains a memory older than six sampled frames
